fields.statement: Verified commit 1b563a4a9. Byte comparison against a scratch build of the parent 1b563a4a9^: change ls and change ls --json in /home/rhiza/code/rhiza identical (6863 lines). In a scratch repo with a junk.json log problem and an out-of-order open entry (fold problem), text and --json were identical to the parent's, order and wording included; after rm -rf of a change set folder, the warm index listed the remaining sets with no stale one, identical to the parent. Note: rewriting an already-indexed entry file in place showed its old problem until the index was rebuilt. That is the index's documented rule (index.go:15, an entry file never changes) and not part of this leaf. Warm change ls 0.42 s.
